items.title: 8.2 AI systems ke saqafati aur akhlaqi asraat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cultural and ethical implications of AI (PDF 112-115).

blocks.text: AI is par asar dalti hai ke log kaise rehte, kaam karte aur technology se taalluq rakhte hain, is liye is ke saqafati aur akhlaqi asraat ko dekhna zaroori hai. AI systems sirf takneeki ijadaat nahi balke samaji tools hain jo afraad, biradariyon aur hukoomaton par asar dalte hain (Fig 8.5).

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Mubahisa: kya AI ko logon ki zindagi par asar dalne wale faisle, jaise naukri ke liye bharti ya talaba ki grading, karne chahiye?

blocks.caption: Stakeholders aur un ki fikrein
rows: AI systems design aur tameer karte, kaam, jiddat aur karkardagi par tawajjuh; systems ko durust, munsif aur akhlaqi banana zaroori
Rozana AI systems use karte aur asani aur aitbaar chahte; raazdari, hifazat aur durust nataij ki fikr
Mehfooz, munsifana istemal ke liye policies aur qawaneen; awami mafadat ki hifazat aur qanoon ka nifaz
Asar mehsoos karti; samaji aqdar aur saqafati riwayat bachane par tawajjuh aur zimmedarana istemal ko farogh

blocks.text: Saqafati tanawwo is par asar dalta hai ke duniya bhar mein AI kaise design, dekhi aur use hoti hai. Saqafati aqdar raazdari, rabte aur technology ke baare mein users ki tawaqqoat banati hain, is liye designers ko maqami riwayat aur rawaiye dekhne chahiye. Kuch muashre data share karne mein aaram mehsoos karte jab ke kuch sakht raazdari mangte hain; zaban ke models mein bohat si zabanein aur lehje (Pakistan ke liye Urdu aur Punjabi, Sindhi, Pashto aur Balochi jaisi ilaqai zabanein) shamil hone chahiye taake ghalib saqafaton ki taraf jhukao na ho; aur AI ke faisle maqami riwayat ka ehtram karein.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Mukhtalif zabanein aur saqafatein samajhne wali AI har pas-e-manzar ke logon ki behtar khidmat kar sakti hai.

items: Insaf: koi imtiyazi sulook nahi. Dakhle ki AI talaba ko jins, ilaqe, zaban ya pas-e-manzar ki wajah se tarjeeh ya radd na kare.
Jawabdehi: koi zimmedar ho. University bata sake ke system ke ghair-munsifana faisle par kaun zimmedar hai.
Shaffafiyat: faisle samjhaye ja sakein, maslan talib-e-ilm kyun chuna ya radd hua.
Hifazat: users nuqsan se mehfooz. Bimari ki tashkhees wali AI ehtiyat se test ho taake nuqsandeh ya gumraah-kun nataij na de.

blocks.text: AI bare datasets se seekhti hai jin mein chhupa bias ho sakta hai. Bharti ka system jo zyada tar aise pichhle record par train ho jin mein mard auraton se zyada chune gaye, mard umeedwaron ko ghair-munsifana tarjeeh de sakta hai; chehra pehchanne wala system jo zyada tar aik umar, rangat ya ilaqe par train ho doosron ke liye kharab chal sakta hai. Developers ko apna data jaanch kar durust karna chahiye, aur shamooliyat wala design mukhtalif nuqta-e-nazar dekhta hai taake technology jins, nasal ya pas-e-manzar se qata-e-nazar sab ki barabar khidmat kare.

blocks.alt: Darmiyani daira 'AI system' chaar stakeholders se jura: developers (durust, munsif systems), users (asani, raazdari, durust nataij), hukoomatein (qawaneen, awami mafad) aur biradariyan (samaji aur saqafati aqdar). Neeche patti usool: insaf (imtiyaz nahi), jawabdehi (koi zimmedar), shaffafiyat (faisle samjhaye ja sakein) aur hifazat (users ko nuqsan nahi).
blocks.caption: AI mein stakeholders aur akhlaqi usool (Fig 8.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Akhlaqi design ka matlab chaaron groups ka tawazun hai, sirf system banane ya paisa dene walon ka nahi.

blocks.text: Takrao tab hota hai jab stakeholders ki tarjeehat mukhtalif hon. Karobar jiddat aur munafe ke liye data jama karna chahte, users apni maloomat ki raazdari aur control ko ahem samajhte, aur hukoomaton ko maashi taraqqi aur shehriyon ke huqooq ka tawazun rakhna hota hai. Maslan company apni AI behtar karne ke liye bohat sa user data jama kar sakti hai, lekin wazeh ijazat ke baghair aisa karna raazdari aur bharose ko torta hai; shaffaf data policies aur saade ijazat ke options faide aur akhlaqiyat ka tawazun rakhne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Raazdari aur jiddat ka tawazun aaj ki technology wali duniya ke sab se bare challenges mein se hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Company ki meeting ka role-play karein jis mein developers user data jama karna chahte aur raazdari ke hami mukhalifat karte hain, aur hal par guftagu karein.

Bain-ul-aqwami dhaanche zimmedarana AI ki rehnumai karte hain. European Union ka General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) data ki raazdari aur users ke huqooq ke sakht qawaid nafiz karta, aur duniya bhar ke idaron ke AI akhlaqi usool jawabdehi, insaf aur insani waqar par zor dete hain. Pakistan ke liye qaumi AI policies jiddat ko farogh aur akhlaqi pabandi yaqeeni banane ke liye ahem hain: yeh data ki hifazat ke qawaid, research ki madad aur AI hal ko maqami aqdar ke mutabiq banane mein madad deti, awami bharosa aur shirakatein badhati hain.

blocks.title: Pakistan ki AI policy
blocks.text: Pakistan ki wafaqi hukoomat ne 2025 mein National Artificial Intelligence Policy manzoor ki. Is ki taaza tafseelat ke liye sarkari dastavezat dekhein.

blocks.prompt: AI talaba ke mazameen check karti aur dehi schools ke talaba ke saadi English mein likhe jawabon ko kam number deti hai. Kaun se akhlaqi usool khatre mein hain, aur kya karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Insaf (aik group ke khilaf bias) aur shaffafiyat (talaba nahi dekh sakte ke number kyun kam hain), aur nataij ki jawabdehi. Training data bias ke liye jaancha jaye, number asatiza dekhein, scoring samjhai jaye, aur istemal se pehle system bohat si qism ke schools ke mazameen par test ho.

items: Stakeholders: developers, users, hukoomatein, biradariyan, har aik ki alag fikrein.
Saqafat aur zaban ka ehtram; usool: insaf, jawabdehi, shaffafiyat, hifazat.
Janibdar data se bachein; wazeh ijazat se mafadat ka tawazun; GDPR aur qaumi AI policy jaise dhaanche.
